summary: Market Technology Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K announcing that commencing September 17, 2026, holders of its IPO units (MTAKU) may elect to separately trade the embedded Class A ordinary shares (MTAK) and redeemable warrants (MTAKW). Each unit comprised one Class A share and one-half of one warrant; only whole warrants trade, so unseparated units continue as MTAKU. CEO Jonathan Slone signed; Continental Stock Transfer & Trust is transfer agent. No business combination, target, price, premium or advisor was disclosed. Watch for a definitive de-SPAC transaction, redemption levels, trust size and warrant overhang.
